label: Attacks seen in three cities, ranked by strength
description: Attacks seen in late October 2024 in three named cities, ranked twice on air by how strong the impression was: Nashville strongest and carrying what he calls a Holy Spirit check, Las Vegas next, New Orleans weakest and described as one rather than many. On 1 January 2025 the deadly attack came in New Orleans, the city he ranked lowest, and the Las Vegas incident that day killed only its driver.
aliases: not as strong in new orleans

label: The 1950s tent revival returns, plugged into a 220 outlet
description: A speaker rising out of the ground and evangelism coming out of the oak tree, with an old 1950s tent revival microphone plugged into a 220 outlet and the movement going through America.

label: A BRICS digital platform to split away from the dollar
description: A private meeting seen in which a digital platform is brought up with the BRICS nations so members can stop pegging to the American dollar, with a BRICS currency as the global currency, alongside Saudi Arabia and the crown prince.
aliases: not being pegged to the dollar
